keyFindings.description: Expired and undecodable copies use up roleKeepDrainMax (20): a role unheld for hours (stream MaxAge 72h) drops 20 old copies, advances the cursor and forwards none of the fresh ones, which then wait for a claim that rarely comes within the hour. 202 kept, never delivered. No test with more than 20 copies.

The cursor compare-and-swap runs once after every forward, so two listeners draining one role (claim on A, takeover on B inside the 60 s drain) both forward every copy, to two holders. The comment at :66-68 describes a guard that does not exist.

The drain forwards without beforeForward (api.go:489-497): an echo to the source session, and a delivery mode the holder does not advertise, are forwarded where the route and lane both refuse them. Kept copies also carry no Sender stamp (noHolder runs before senderStamp).

publishHandler keeps for any role token the KV alphabet admits, but roleSetHandler refuses anything outside rolePattern (^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*$): an uppercase hand-formatted token, once a correctable 404, is now 202 kept and expires unread.
A keep stored after a concurrent claim's drain read the lane waits for the next claim and usually expires; nothing re-resolves the holder after a keep.

The role lane keeps for a lapsed holder whose claim is retained (the route deliberately does not, confirmed.go:415); a holder that re-registers inside the grace writes no claim, so the copy is never drained.

tellArchitect publishes with keep unset, so a stall notice to an unheld architect is answered 202, marked reported, and dropped after an hour; before, every later reminder retried until an architect held the role. A sender with its own retry should send keep:false.

StreamSubjects now includes the private kept prefix and each consumer filter must remember DurableNotificationSubjects; tests still build listener durables from StreamSubjects. Keep StreamSubjects the consumer list and add the kept subject only where the stream is configured.

KEPT_TOPIC_PREFIX, keptRoleSubject and keptRoleCursorSubject have no TypeScript caller; the Go copy is hand-written in gen-go.ts and generated.go. Listener-only subjects belong in internal/bus beside ExceptionTopicPrefix.
Package-global roleKeepDrains and a cfg == nil branch that exists only for tests; put the guard set on listenerDeliveryHandlerConfig like deferredUnplaceable and wire delivery in the tests.

No `## Contract change census`: the publish route's answer to an unheld role changes from 404 to 202 at a process boundary (and gains the keep field and kept_at); the body must list every caller of POST /v1/messages/publish for a role topic, in and outside this repository, with a disposition each.

Security[authz] hardening: publishHandler stores any notifications.envoy.kept.* topic, so a bearer holder can rewind a role's cursor (an envelope decodes as {kept:0}) or forge a kept copy. Refuse the kept prefix in publishHandler.
The keep call is duplicated in the unclaimed and default branches; one call before the switch does the same.
PublishStoredOn and PublishStoredAs wrap one function; the only production caller discards the bool.
keptReason union hand-copied from the zod enum at :109; derive it.
